translations.web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
translations.bsb: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.
translations.kjv: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
translations.asv: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: A fire not blown by man shall devour him; It shall consume that which is left in his tent.
